The most common win left on "EMERALD MINE 9X" is $5. The second biggest prize left is $10,000, and eight of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

Everything here about "EMERALD MINE 9X" comes from official Florida lottery numbers, current through November 1.
5055.headline: A close look at the prizes

5057.body:
The most common win left on "EASY MONEY" is $2. The second biggest prize left is $10,000, and two of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

Today's free summary of "EASY MONEY" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
5057.headline: What's actually left to win

5059.body:
THE CASH WHEEL's prizes make it a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. Of the prize money still unclaimed, about three-quarters is in wins under $500. The prize counts change every day, but this design does not.

If "THE CASH WHEEL" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
5059.headline: How the prize money is divided

5060.body:
"FIND THE 7S" is near the end of its run, with about a quarter of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, a smaller share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a reason to be careful.

The numbers for "FIND THE 7S" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
5060.headline: How far along this game is

5063.body:
